description:
ABOUT OUR BRAND + PRODUCTS

Soulidago = women’s health, with heart. We create science-led, California-crafted supplements that feel real, gentle, and finally made for you.

What makes us different

WHAT WE BELIEVE
Empathy
We see you—your body, your cycle, your story. Our care is emotionally intelligent and grounded in lived experience—never dismissive, never one-size-fits-all.

Expert Formulation
Practitioner-informed, science-backed formulations using clean, bioavailable ingredients. We’re honest about timelines: benefits build with consistent use over 2–3 months, not overnight.

Inclusivity
Designed for real women—across ages, hormones, lifestyles, and lived experiences.

OUR VISION: Redefine women’s wellness with care that is clean, credible, emotionally intelligent, and truly transformative.

OUR MISSION: Science-backed, soul-first solutions designed to fit into your life—not overwhelm it.

Flagship product: Headicure™

Headicure is a daily ritual rooted in science—created for women ready to feel steady, supported, and seen (a simple three-capsule routine designed to support head comfort and clearer thinking over time).


Formulated with 16 evidence-based nutrients including magnesium glycinate, riboflavin (B2), vitamin D, vitamin B6 and more.

           

Also in our line (coming soon):

  • Pericure (hormonal balance + cycle + mood/stress support)

  • InnerCalm (mood support for stress response)

  • Glow & Tell (glowing skin + hair + nails support)

HOW AFFILIATES CAN EARN

  • Commission: Earn on every sale tracked through your unique UpPromote link/code (see current commission rate inside the platform).

    • Earn ~ $9 per order on average (18% commission)
    • Plus, you can share a 10% off code for your audience.
    • Plus 18% commission on all Prepaid Plan Subscription orders.
      • 3-month supply ships every three months
        • Total price: $132.00 (Price per jar: $44.00)  Free Shipping!
      • 2-month supply ships every two months
        • Total price: $93.50 (Price per jar: $46.75) Free Shipping!
      • 1-month supply ships every month
        • Total price: $49.50
        • Free Shipping!

  • Creator perk: Free product + a unique audience discount code (10% off).

  • Optional extras: Giveaways, seasonal boosts, and founder-led features for top partners.

Expectations (flexible): 1–2 pieces of content/month or share when it genuinely fits your audience and story.

HOW TO PROMOTE US

Best-performing angles:

  • “Women’s wellness that is real, gentle and finally made for you.” 

  • Headicure is a daily ritual rooted in science created for women ready to feel steady, supported and seen on their own terms.

  • Research shows that many women with headaches, migraines and brain fog have low levels of magnesium, vitamin B2, vitamin D and iron.

  • Our prevention supplement formula combines 16 evidence based nutrients shown to support neurological stability, hormonal balance and energy metabolism.

  • Ritual + consistency: “steady support over 2–3 months” (set expectations clearly).  It may take 2-3 months of consistent use to feel the full effects, but many feel them earlier!

  • This is a headache and migraine support supplement that is the result of careful research, collaboration with health practitioners, and deep respect for clinical science and natural wisdom.

  • Transparency + standards: what’s in it, why it’s there, and how it’s made

Content formats that work well:

  • GRWM / morning routine: “my 3-capsule ritual”

  • UGC testimonial + “why I chose this formula”

  • Educational reels: magnesium glycinate + riboflavin + women’s neuro-nutrition (no wild claims)

  • Your story + “support that fits real life”

  • Women report:

    •  "No intense migraines!"

    • "I feel the difference throughout the day, with less pain and more energy."  

    • "I am less fatigued both body and mind"

    • "I have less migraines and I am more clear headed."

    • "I have noticed an improvement in my mood and brain fog."

    • "I appreciate that there is so much in one formula."

Compliance notes (important):
Please avoid disease-treatment promises or “instant cure” language. 

OTHER INFORMATION (QUALITY + TRUST)

  • Made in California in a GMP certified facility.

  • Vegan, Non-GMO, Gluten-Free, Made by Women for Women, Cruelty-Free; no artificial flavors/colors/dyes.

  • Follows FDA cGMP practices; products are tested for identity/purity/strength and screened for contaminants (e.g., heavy metals/microbes).

  • Certificate of Analysis (COA) per lot is part of our transparency promise.

  • Shipping: currently within the USA.

  • No Regrets Guarantee: risk-free trial for first purchase (30 day refund). We want to empower you to try our products risk-free for 30 days! We trust that you will love our products but if you are not satisfied, you can request a refund within 30 days of your very first purchase.
payout_period: Monthly on the 15th of each month
